summary: Community web app (Gram Sansad) with announcement system, user registration with Aadhaar upload, and community chat with messaging, media sharing, and polls
architectural_notes: PWA architecture for Android-like experience with home screen installation
Push notification system for announcements with custom sound alerts
File upload system for Aadhaar card images (front and back)
Real-time chat functionality with media support (images and videos)
Poll system integrated within chat interface
known_issues: YHash must be exactly 32 bytes, got 64 - error occurring during profile creation

existing_features.title: Create user registration form collecting name, father name, age, mobile number, WhatsApp number, state, district, and village fields with validation
Add Aadhaar card photo upload functionality to registration form supporting two separate image uploads for front and back sides
Create announcement creation interface for administrators to compose and broadcast announcements to all users
Add browser notification with custom sound that triggers when announcements arrive to alert users distinctly from other notifications
Create community chat interface displaying messages in chronological order with support for text, photos, and videos similar to messaging apps
Add poll creation feature to community chat allowing users to create polls with multiple options

Design a cohesive visual theme for Gram Sansad with warm, community-focused colors (earth tones, greens, or traditional Indian palette), clear typography suitable for diverse age groups, and organized layout emphasizing accessibility and ease of use for rural community members

Debug and fix the profile creation failure that occurs when users enter their name in the profile setup modal, ensuring the createProfile backend call succeeds and properly initializes the user profile
Add error logging and validation to the profile creation flow to capture the root cause of failures, including backend error responses, authentication state issues, or data validation problems

Fix the YHash serialization error that occurs during profile creation by ensuring the hash value passed to the backend is exactly 32 bytes instead of 64 bytes, investigating the ExternalBlob conversion or hash generation in the ProfileSetupModal component
Verify that the ExternalBlob structure for aadharPhoto in ProfileSetupModal correctly initializes with empty byte arrays that serialize to valid 32-byte hashes when sent to the backend

new_feature_requests.summary: Announcement system with custom notification sound for all users
User registration form with name, father name, age, mobile, WhatsApp number, state, district, village, and Aadhaar card photo upload (both sides)
Community chat tab with text messages, photo sharing, and video sharing
Poll creation feature within community chat
Implement backend user registration endpoint storing all registration data including name, father name, age, mobile number, WhatsApp number, state, district, village, and Aadhaar photo references
Implement backend announcement system that stores announcements and delivers them to all registered users with notification support
Implement backend chat message storage and retrieval supporting text messages, photo attachments, and video attachments
Implement backend poll system storing poll questions, options, user votes, and results accessible to all community members
